greatBuilding.available: Bonuses from the official wiki up to level {count}. Beyond, they are computed (≈): with the exact formula of their progression when there is one, otherwise with an approximate curve fitted on the known levels.
greatBuilding.notFound: This Great Building does not exist.
greatBuilding.computed: ≈: computed value, not checked in game
greatBuilding.manualNote: Some bonuses of this GB are computed with an approximate formula (within ±0.1), fitted on values read in game: the levels read show the exact value.
greatBuilding.readingsNote: Bonuses from level 81 to {level} come from players' readings collected by FOE Assistant (foe-assistant.com), where known.
greatBuilding.betaNote: Prestige rework, from the beta server's data: copper bonuses grow up to level 200, gold bonuses (21 GBs) from level 101 to 500. Exact values at levels 1, 101, 201, 301, 401 and 500, very close in between (curve measured in game); approximate costs (≈). Max level of this GB: {level}.
greatBuilding.betaWarning: Warning: beta data is very volatile and changes very often, it may no longer match what you see in game.

betaBadgeTitle.gold: This Great Building has the gold tier on the beta (prestige rework)
betaBadgeTitle.copper: This Great Building stays at the copper tier on the beta (prestige rework), max level 200

rush.estimated: Some rewards are estimated (±5 FP): FoE Helper has no record for these levels yet.

compare.title: Comparison
compare.empty: Add buildings or Great Buildings with the “Compare” button to see them side by side.
compare.limit: Up to {max} items: the oldest one is removed beyond.

city.title: My city
city.importTitle: Import your city from FoE Helper
city.step1: In Forge of Empires, open FoE Helper, then the city map.
city.step2: Click "Download" to get a .json file, or "Copy".
city.step3: Choose the file here, or paste what you copied. Do it again when your city changes.
city.invalid: This is not a FoE Helper city export.
city.clipboard: Can't read the clipboard: use the file instead.
city.privacy: Your city stays in your browser: nothing is sent to a server.
city.summary: {count} buildings recognized, each rated at its own age (the building's when it keeps one, yours otherwise), from least to most profitable. A chain counts with all its attached links (+N), a set building with its neighbours' bonuses. Great Buildings are tagged GB and ranked below 0.
city.scoreSettings: The score follows the settings above, shared with the wiki.
city.unknown: {count} building(s) not rated: town hall, buildings the game does not describe…
city.localOnly: Building missing from the wiki: rated with its game definition, from your export
city.mapHint: Hover a building to see its score; click to open its page.
city.mapUpdate: Update your city (button above) to see the land and roads.
